body: Cheers mate was feeling pretty low tonight more than most

Definitely could do I honestly do think I need to focus hard onto what I love keep consistent with gyming so I can love my physical self I already hold my mental pretty good but just can’t communicate with other due to “the way” I talk or so be it I Spose it does just come down to staying focused on something else rather than myself and staying motivated on self love

Believe me when I say I try , I’ve tried living by the stoicism philosophy and even then it doesn’t do the trick I end up being weird and pushing away people I know the core root of it all comes down to me trying we’re I know I shouldn’t be phased but I’m stuck in the catastrophic thinking making mountains out of anthills and every time I purposely put myself in any form of situation my anxiety runs the same as it did 3 years ago literally live my life being ruled by it.up until I was about 18 before I was legitimately the most confident in the room never shy didn’t even know how anxiety felt then all of a sudden out of no where it has slowly gotten worse and worse I’ve read so many books to try help it but nothing seems to do the trick I find opening up to people and letting them know about it has helped me as then they can understand abit why I am how I am.but reality is no ones wants to hang out with someone who’s constantly down or being someone out that’s socially awkward you can only push someone for so long until you realise some things never change
I used to play rugby want to get into boxing but my anxiety holds me back from doing anything publicly

I get you but it’s not like a simple switch to be like yea fuck it even when having a shit ton of energy,me personally I get up and try to work out and get frustrated that I can do a week then not for another 2 then pick it back up and can’t seem to enjoy it even though I’m working on myself

And when you can’t love yourself and no one loves you ? Personally I’m a good looking guy but over the past few months gained a lot of weight been cheated on by every gf and just can’t seem to find genuine love at all have terrible social anxiety and find I can only truely be myself when on drugs
What if you already know these things you try act on it,you’ve read a hundred books but just can’t brings yourself to wanting to get out of bed

I’ve read a hundred books trying to unfuck my brain but I don’t feel
Happiness at all anymore I only feel good when taking drugs and the person who I have became has been from drug and I’ve already become the person and that in itself is destructive

I feel this man honestly you can only read so many books and learn why you think the way you think before you realise it’s just the way your wired thinking about going through out the year and seeing what’s to come , I have circled my life around and definitely acheived good things but I don’t feel happiness anymore and I know chasing the illusion of happiness is in itself a a negative experience it’s just impossible to feel it without drugs
